# Kushmanda — Sati's own language model (`sati-kushmanda-v1`)

decoder-only transformer: RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, fused causal attention, tied embeddings, **34.1M parameters**, trained from random initialisation on `cuda`: 8,000 pretraining steps, then 2,000 instruction-tuning steps.

**Corpus** (cleaned and deduplicated): 22,153 documents — mitre-attack 3,652, mitre-attack-procedure 14,431, mitre-capec 1,207, mitre-cwe 917, cisa-kev 1,678, repository 268. 1,090 held out by document; 1,088,711 training tokens.

## What the training curve shows

Held-out loss was lowest at step 400 (3.6133) and ended at 5.9768 by step 8,000, while training loss fell to 0.0359. After step 400 the model was memorising its training text rather than learning the language: **overfitting**. The step-400 checkpoint is the one kept and evaluated.
